index.about.description: Ugrow is an academic project by Guilherme Veiga Pedromilo through ICETI. contact.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
contact.faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most common questions before reaching out
contact.faq.q1.question: Is Ugrow free to use?
contact.faq.q1.answer: Yes. Ugrow is a free academic project, with no paid plans or hidden charges.
contact.faq.q2.question: Is my financial data safe?
contact.faq.q2.answer: Your financial information stays on your own device and is never shared with third parties.
contact.faq.q3.question: Which platforms are supported?
contact.faq.q3.answer: Ugrow is available for Windows, macOS and Linux. Check the Downloads page for the latest installers.
contact.faq.q4.question: How do I report a bug or suggest a feature?
contact.faq.q4.answer: Use the form above and choose "Problems in the App" or "Feedback" as the request type.
contact.faq.q5.question: Where can I find the user manual?
contact.faq.q5.answer: The full user manual is available on the Documentation page, in both Portuguese and English.

about.hero.title: About Ugrow
about.hero.subtitle: Ugrow, an innovative solution to manage your personal finances on your computer
about.creator.title: Who is the Creator?
about.creator.description: Guilherme Veiga Pedromilo is a Software Engineering student at UniCesumar (in training), Systems Developer and Electroelectronics Technician by SENAI. Currently, he is an IT Intern in BRM (Business Relationship Management) at ZF Automotive (ZF Group). Furthermore, he is a musician and academic violinist at the Symphony Orchestra of the Heitor Villa-Lobos School (Americana-SP).
about.idea.title: Idea and Project
about.idea.description: The idea was born from the creator's need to manage his own finances, and from noticing that people talk a lot about financial control but most of them don't actually have a good handle on it. So the goal is to create a desktop app for people to manage their finances and learn a little about how to save money.
about.institutions.title: Institutions Involved
about.institutions.description: UniCesumar (Cesumar University) and ICETI (Cesumar Institute of Technology and Innovation) are the institutions involved in this project, contributing with their teachers, content and materials, as well as financial and technical support. They work together as official partners, committed to education, innovation and the scientific community.

documentation.article.overview.title: Project Overview
documentation.article.overview.descripti: The need to control personal finances is not new. Many people who are unfamiliar with the subject or who have problems managing their finances in life seek to organize them somehow. However, due to limited knowledge in personal finance organization, the high volume of content about the subject on social media, and the advent of technology with countless solutions such as control apps, which are often expensive or complex to use, people end up having great difficulty making a decision and knowing the best way to control their debts throughout the month.

This academic project aims to solve the problem mentioned in the context above, meaning, through a multi-platform desktop application, people can control their debts in an organized and simple way, and also learn more about financial education through digital content and materials offered within the application.
documentation.article.official_doc.title: Official Documentation
documentation.article.official_doc.descr: All academic and technical documentation, files and source code are available through the Ugrow-Social-App organization on GitHub.
The documentation repository contains all the project's official documents.
The project timeline and backlog present all the project's completed, ongoing and future tasks and actions. It is available to everyone.
